scripts.title: Automated Dabux Navigation
scripts.features:
You must collect the dabux manually before 40 seconds of the script being used before the 2nd Teleportation happens so be quick ,Teleportation Logic
Targeting: The script automatically detects the two largest clusters.
Initial Jump: It will immediately teleport to the first (largest) cluster upon activation.
Cooldown: A 40 second delay is required after the initial jump before the script will automatically teleport to the second biggest cluster.
scripts.script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function getRankedClusters()
    local allDabux = {}
    local clusters = {}
    
    -- 1. Scan the map for Dabux
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "Dabux" then
            local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if part then 
                table.insert(allDabux, part) 
            end
        end
    end

    -- 2. Group by density (30 stud radius)
    for _, primary in pairs(allDabux) do
        local neighbors = 0
        for _, secondary in pairs(allDabux) do
            if (primary.Position - secondary.Position).Magnitude <= 30 then
                neighbors = neighbors + 1
            end
        end
        table.insert(clusters, {cf = primary.CFrame, count = neighbors})
    end

    -- 3. Rank them
    table.sort(clusters, function(a, b) return a.count > b.count end)
    return clusters
end

-- PHASE 1: THE BIGGEST PILE
local rankedList = getRankedClusters()

if #rankedList >= 1 then
    local first = rankedList[1]
    print("Teleporting to #1 Cluster (" .. first.count .. " Dabux within 30 studs)")
    root.CFrame = first.cf * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)

    -- PHASE 2: THE 40-SECOND WAIT
    print("Teleported. Staying here for 40 seconds...")
    task.wait(40)

    -- PHASE 3: THE SECOND BIGGEST PILE
    rankedList = getRankedClusters()
    
    if #rankedList >= 2 then
        local second = rankedList[2]
        print("Moving to #2 Cluster (" .. second.count .. " Dabux within 30 studs)")
        root.CFrame = second.cf * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
        print("Finished. Enjoy your Dabux.")
    else
        print("No second cluster found.")
    end
else
    print("No Dabux found on the map.")
end
